author: Glass Reflection
description:
When I originally ranked this season, I laid out an entire S-Tier of heavy-hitting shows, only to end up putting highly-anticipated titles like Saga of Tanya the Evil on hold. Instead, what actually captured my attention was a bizarrely well-animated chain-smoking cat, alongside several grounded, character-driven comfort shows that managed to sneak onto my completed list.

In this video, we are judging my Summer 2026 season based solely on the anime I actually finished. We look into the absolute surprise hit of the season, try (and fail) to untangle the time-travel debacle in Reincarnated as a Slime, talk about the harsh realities of the manga industry, and discuss a few shows that completely fumbled their finales. 

🕒 Navigate the Review:
0:00 - My Tier List was...off (Expectation vs. Reality)
01:15 - Chainsmoker Cat: The Vulgar Surprise Hit
03:17 - Mushoku Tensei & Making a Simpsons Reference
04:21 - The Slime Time-Travel...thing
06:54 - Comfort Watch: Smoking Behind the Supermarket
title: Summer 2026 Anime: What I ACTUALLY Finished
